items.description: This is the primary international airport serving Eswatini, located near Sikhuphe. It handles regional and international flights, acting as a gateway to the country.
A significant agricultural community focused on sugar production in the eastern part of the country. It features planned housing, schools, and extensive cane fields.
A rugged mountain range located in the southern part of Eswatini, known for its scenic views and challenging terrain.
These hills are situated near the capital city, providing a dramatic backdrop and contributing to the varied topography of the region.
Also known as the Barberton Greenstone Belt, these mountains contain some of the oldest exposed rock formations on Earth.
A prominent geographic feature running along the eastern border of Eswatini, separating the lowveld from the coastal plain of Mozambique.
This central region of Eswatini is characterized by rolling hills, fertile valleys, and a temperate climate suitable for diverse agriculture.
A deep, expansive valley providing essential drainage and fertile land for the central regions of Eswatini.
A notable plantation forest area in the highveld, contributing significantly to the country's timber and forestry sector.
An important forestry area in the northern part of Eswatini, featuring managed timber estates and mountain landscapes.
A forest region situated in the south, essential for regional biodiversity and sustainable land use practices.
